arguments.code:
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'count',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('total_playlists',len(all_playlists))
# gather song_ids
song_ids=[]
for pl in all_playlists:
    song_ids.extend(pl.get('song_ids',[]))
print('total_song_instances',len(song_ids))
unique_song_ids=sorted(set(song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids',len(unique_song_ids),unique_song_ids)

song_details=[]
max_like=-1
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    d=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title=d.get('title')
    like_count=d.get('like_count')
    print({'song_id':sid,'title':title,'like_count':like_count})
    song_details.append({'song_id':sid,'title':title,'like_count':like_count})
    if like_count is not None and like_count>max_like:
        max_like=like_count
max_candidates=[s for s in song_details if s['like_count']==max_like]
print('max_like',max_like,'num_candidates',len(max_candidates))
print('candidates',[c['title'] for c in sorted(max_candidates,key=lambda x:(x['title'] or ''))])
chosen=sorted(max_candidates,key=lambda x:(x['title'] or ''))[0]
print('chosen',chosen)

answer='A Love That Never Was'
print('answer',answer)
res=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer)
print(res)
